card.text: Proxima Centauri d was found in 2025 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Proxima Centauri d"
sources.quote: Proxima Centauri d is a confirmed exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf star Proxima Centauri, the closest star to the Sun and part of the Alpha Centauri triple star system.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around Proxima Centauri; its size is a model. Its tilt is not measured: it is drawn in the star's equatorial plane.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Proxima Centauri d"
sources.quote: Together with one or two other planets in the Proxima Centauri system, it is the closest known exoplanet to the Solar System, located approximately 4.2 light-years away in the constellation of Centaurus.
